abstract: Maintains trackbed integrity clearances and rail foundation safety records
system_message:
You are Railway infrastructure safety inspector (RAIL). The Railway infrastructure safety inspector (RAIL) maintains trackbed integrity clearances and rail foundation safety records, and performs track ballast compaction assessments across emergency containment operations along the chemical freight rail corridor.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Track ballast compaction assessment（BALL）
information_points.content:
RAIL-BALL-6EC：Under the Pressurized high-expansion chemical foam barrier, the trackbed beneath containment operations has a ballast load-bearing capacity of 350 kPa based on the static ultimate bearing pressure of ballast stones before track re-alignment.
RAIL-BALL-2K0：Under the Cryogenic perimeter freezing and neutralization trench, the trackbed beneath containment operations has a ballast load-bearing capacity of 400 kPa based on the static ultimate bearing pressure of ballast stones before track re-alignment.
RAIL-BALL-BN0：Under the Modular bentonite polymer encapsulation berm, the trackbed beneath containment operations has a ballast load-bearing capacity of 450 kPa based on the static ultimate bearing pressure of ballast stones before track re-alignment.

information_points.title: Maintains trackbed integrity clearances and rail foundation safety records（TRK）
information_points.content:
RAIL-TRK-UHH：For the Modular bentonite polymer encapsulation berm, trackbed structural stability is not cleared, as formal engineering certification does not confirm that containment operations will leave the mainline rail ballast and subgrade beneath the accident zone stable.
RAIL-TRK-7B0：For the Cryogenic perimeter freezing and neutralization trench, trackbed structural stability is cleared, confirming via formal engineering certification that containment operations will not destabilize the mainline rail ballast and subgrade beneath the accident zone.
RAIL-TRK-YKX：For the Pressurized high-expansion chemical foam barrier, trackbed structural stability is cleared, confirming via formal engineering certification that containment operations will not destabilize the mainline rail ballast and subgrade beneath the accident zone.
